parsed.explanation: Positives: no criminalisation of same-sex conduct, national anti-discrimination law covering gender identity (2016), hate-crime enhancements in multiple entities, no documented universal facility restriction or border/document exposure. Negatives: documented organised violence at LGBT events — a 2008 festival stormed, 2014 Pride attacked despite prior police coordination (court found state failure), 2023 police cancelled screenings and activists were chased — with no prosecution record. A 2024 monitor reports worsening trend. Surveys show deeply hostile attitudes (84% opposed to same-sex marriage). Healthcare stigma documented. No evidence of state-perpetrated universal exposure against visitors; harms cluster around public LGBT visibility and events a typical tourist need not attend. The dossier lacks documented visitor-specific targeting, custody/facility rules, or police extortion of trans travellers. Anti-discrimination law exists but enforcement for visitors is unproven. Net: elevated risk from hostile society plus intermittent organised violence with weak accountability, but no criminalisation or institutional exclusion.
